hints.title: Trailing Zero Requirement
hints.text: For row i in an n by n grid, there must be at least n - 1 - i trailing zeros to satisfy upper triangular requirements.

hints.title: Greedy First Match Selection
hints.text: For row i, search downward starting at index i for the first available row with at least n - 1 - i trailing zeros.

hints.title: Bubble Up and Swap Count
hints.text: Bubble the matched row up to index i using adjacent swaps, adding j - i to the swap counter. If no row satisfies the condition, return -1.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all row permutations is factorial.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting trailing zeros per row takes O(N^2) and greedy bubbling takes O(N^2) time and O(N) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate abstracts the grid rows into trailing zero counts and applies greedy inversion bubbling.
complexity.notes: Upper triangular requires all cells above main diagonal to have sufficient zeros below them.
